{{Libra}}
Libra 15 is the 295th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 15th day of Libra, and it is a Monday. It corresponds to ISO week 43, weekday 1.

Its informal Japanese name is 11宮15日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 295|Chapter 295]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152314}}.
